name: vtt
description: Serverless browser-only Virtual Tabletop — single self-contained index.html (host = GM tab)

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm build:systems && node tools/convert/index.mjs --allow-missing && pnpm build:worlds && playwright test
scripts.test:fx:prepare: vite build && node scripts/buildSystemPackages.mjs && node scripts/buildStarterWorlds.mjs
scripts.test:fx:automation: playwright test --project=chromium --workers=1 --retries=0 --global-timeout=900000 e2e/active_zones.spec.ts e2e/automation_appearance.spec.ts e2e/movement_actions.spec.ts e2e/action_revert.spec.ts
scripts.test:fx:integrations: playwright test --project=chromium --workers=1 --retries=0 --global-timeout=900000 e2e/fx_item_binding.spec.ts e2e/prefabs.spec.ts e2e/script_macros.spec.ts e2e/script_result_branch.spec.ts e2e/summon_script.spec.ts e2e/summon_zone.spec.ts e2e/summons.spec.ts
scripts.test:fx:canvas: playwright test --project=chromium --workers=1 --retries=0 --global-timeout=900000 e2e/assets.spec.ts e2e/canvas_rail.spec.ts e2e/canvas_toolbar.spec.ts e2e/join.spec.ts e2e/vision.spec.ts e2e/walls.spec.ts e2e/fog.spec.ts e2e/fog_lighting.spec.ts e2e/fog_player.spec.ts
